title: Richardson Electronics Reports Third Quarter Results; Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: Third-Quarter Net Income of $0.9 million, or $0.07 per diluted share. Q3 FY26 net sales increase led by a 9.7% YoY increase in PMT net sales. Total backlog at February 28, 2026, was up 11.4% from end of the fiscal second quarter Read the full press release here
body_markdown:
*Third-Quarter Net Income of $0.9 million, or $0.07 per diluted share.* *Q3 FY26 net sales increase led by a 9.7% YoY increase in* *PMT net sales.* *Total backlog at February 28, 2026, was up 11.4% from end of the fiscal second quarter*
